HR port provenance

Donor: refinedev/refine, examples/refine-hr-ce
Repository: https://github.com/refinedev/refine
Pinned commit: 2352eb5b6539e2f39ad9aef652279ad1dcf2c467
Source: https://github.com/refinedev/refine/tree/2352eb5b6539e2f39ad9aef652279ad1dcf2c467/examples/refine-hr-ce
Donor license: MIT; original text is preserved verbatim in LICENSE.txt and
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Its checksum is verified before release.

The retained Material UI HR screens, leave cards, request lists, modals, themes,
and icons derive from this donor. House-backed data providers, app initialization,
and local identity selection are port modifications. Login/server integrations
are removed. The commercial MUI Pro date-range calendar is replaced with the
community MUI DateCalendar; no MUI Pro license grant is inferred from the donor.
Font assets are distributed locally from @fontsource/inter; their original SIL
Open Font License appears in combined notices and a separate font notice file.
No remote font service is needed.

THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt is generated from installed, lockfile-pinned production
dependencies. This is a superset of the actual bundled modules. Package license
identifiers and original distributed license/copyright/notice files are retained.
Build-only dependencies are not described as distributed runtime components.
Any package-root license-text omissions supplemented by upstream texts are
identified with exact source URL, package version, and checksum in the generator
and audit report. Supplemental texts do not change the package's declared license.

Known platform licensing gap: @agentshouse/app-bridge declares UNLICENSED and
includes no license grant. Technical checks do not establish authorization to
redistribute this package or make the combined bundle wholly MIT-licensed.

Static release checks do not replace runtime/browser acceptance testing or legal
review. This provenance record does not assert independent third-party clearance
beyond the specific donor and package notices retained in the release.

Build-time optional-feature adaptations preserve surrounding dependency code and
original notices. Exact version, AST-node checksum, and single-match guards remove
React Router 7.18.2's unused framework module loader and Refine's dormant telemetry
sink. Explicit local routes and the documented disableTelemetry option are used.
House bridge and Runtime source are not transformed.

Dependency compatibility note: the donor package ranges requested @refinedev/core
5.2.0 and @refinedev/mui 8.0.3, which were unavailable in the registry during this
port. The port uses exact available @refinedev/core 5.0.12 and @refinedev/mui 8.0.2
within the same major APIs. All actual versions, grants, and notice texts are
reported from package-lock.json and installed package contents.

Additional reviewed optional features are disabled with exact version, AST-node
SHA-256 and single-match guards: PapaParse 5.7.0 remote CSV/worker helpers, MUI
Material 6.5.0 Avatar image loading (initials fallback), and React Router 7.18.2
server-component redirect handling. Local routes, parsing and donor avatar styles
are retained. Every byte outside each reviewed AST node is preserved.

The community calendar preserves the donor-styled start/end selection layout but
does not reproduce the commercial Pro integrated single-range/drag interaction.
Refine MUI's transitive Lab/notistack peer warnings remain a browser-compatibility
caveat, documented in RELEASE_AUDIT.md; no unsupported claim of equivalence is made.
